title: A dream where I acted so like my real self
content: I was in a large store in the mall and I was waiting in the checkout line with a few items. The cashier and her staff member partner said to me "you'll have to put those back we're about to close". When I asked why they gave me some guff about imminent strike action. I said well if you're all going to go on strike why can't I just take the items and walk out?! And I took my items and started to walk out. But behind me I heard the cashier on the mic directing someone towards me for a "code 12". So I decided to not leave so they couldn't accuse me of shoplifting and I would tell them I was just putting the items back as requested. There were still people in the checkout queue though. I said to this teenager don't bother they aren't going to serve you. He said they were already serving him. I looked and they were and I knew he wasn't in front of me in the queue. So I stormed back to the cashier and was like what the f, ring my items through the f now! Why did you tell me you were going on strike when you weren't? She said they had to pretend to be going on strike to trick someone else who was behaving in a threatening manner. So then I realised I was also behaving in a threatening manner so I put my items down and mumbled annoying apology and ran out.
